questions.question:
**Choose the word that means the same as the given word.**

Laggard
questions.solution:
Here the correct answer is **Dawdling. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word that means the same as** "laggard"** is: **Dawdling.**
 
• **"Laggard" (**आलसी आदमी) refers to **a person who is slow, sluggish, or falls behind in progress, work, or movement. **It describes someone who is lacking in speed or efficiency.
 
• **Examples:**
 
 
• The **laggard **student always turned in assignments late, causing him to fall behind his classmates.
 
• The company's slow adoption of new technology made them a **laggard **in their industry.
 
 
 
• **"Dawdling" **refers to** the act of moving or acting slowly, wasting time, or delaying progress**(सुस्‍ती से चलना, धीरे धीरे चलना**).** It implies a lack of urgency or a tendency to procrastinate. When someone is dawdling, they may be taking longer than necessary to complete a task or lingering without purpose.
 
• Examples of the word "**dawdling**" in use:
 
 
• "We're going to be late if you keep **dawdling**. Please hurry up!"
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Now let's analyze the other options:
 
• **Prompt -** This word means to act quickly, without delay, or on time. It is the opposite of "laggard" and does not convey the same meaning. (बिना बिलंब किया (कार्य))
 
• **Hustler -** This word refers to someone who is involved in fraudulent or unscrupulous methods to obtain money. It does not carry the same meaning as "laggard" and implies a different level of motivation and effort. (उद्योगी)
 
• **Expeditious -** This word means quick, efficient, or done with speed (शीघ्र). While it is related to being efficient, it does not capture the sense of falling behind or being slow that is associated with "laggard."
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is** option 3) Dawdling,** as it conveys the same meaning as **"laggard"** by describing someone who is slow, sluggish, or takes too much time to complete tasks.
